Construct a lens specification (a registry record)

Source: R/registry.R
lens_spec.Rd

Construct a lens specification (a registry record)

Usage

lens_spec(
  id,
  label,
  tier,
  independence_key,
  role,
  exactness,
  maturity_tier,
  family_support,
  feature_support,
  emits_loglik,
  fit_fn = NULL,
  implemented = FALSE,
  emits_evidence = FALSE,
  structure_variant = FALSE,
  validation_ref = NULL
)

Arguments

id

Stable key, e.g. "dram".

label

Human-readable label.

tier

1 (R/C++ native), 2 (opt-in C++), or 3 (opt-in Python).

independence_key

list(family =, kernel =) (Stage-0 SS10).

role

"opinion" (enters stacking) or "diagnostic" (never stacked).

exactness

"exact", "approximate", or "resampled".

maturity_tier

One of the maturity tiers (Stage-0 SS11).

family_support

Predicate (family_spec) -> logical.

feature_support

A list(random_effects, distributional, nonlinear, met). met (default FALSE) flags a mixed-model lens that also covers the MET structure of two crossed/nested random intercepts.

emits_loglik

TRUE if the lens emits a pointwise log-likelihood natively; FALSE means koine computes it via the family spec.

fit_fn

The adapter function(pass, lens_spec) -> koine_fb_fit, or NULL if not yet implemented in this build.

implemented

TRUE if fit_fn is a working adapter.

emits_evidence

TRUE if the lens yields a marginal likelihood.

structure_variant

TRUE if the lens fits an alternative model structure (e.g. a robust-t likelihood) rather than a different inference method on the same model — the source of genuine stacking diversity.

validation_ref

Optional identifier (e.g. a ledger cairn id) recording the SBC / reference-posterior evidence behind a koine-implemented-validated maturity tier (Stage-0 SS11). NULL means no validation evidence is on record — a koine-first lens without it is treated as experimental by the maturity gate, never silently trusted (open-arms correctness, SS11).

Value

A koine_lens_spec.

Examples

lens_spec(
  id = "demo", label = "Demonstration lens", tier = 1L,
  independence_key = list(family = "random_walk", kernel = "demo"),
  role = "opinion", exactness = "exact",
  maturity_tier = "reference-validated",
  family_support = function(fs) fs$name == "gaussian",
  feature_support = list(random_effects = FALSE, distributional = FALSE,
                         nonlinear = FALSE, met = FALSE),
  emits_loglik = FALSE)
#> <koine lens_spec 'demo'>
#>   Demonstration lens
#>   tier 1 | role opinion | random_walk/demo | reference-validated
#>   implemented: FALSE
